verses.text: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.

xrefs.text: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,
Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth— let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

verses.text: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.

xrefs.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.

The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear when I speak with you, and they will always put their trust in you.” And Moses relayed to the LORD what the people had said.
Wicked behavior is detestable for kings, for a throne is established through righteousness.
But about the Son He says: “Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.

Far be it from You to do such a thing— to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike. Far be it from You! Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?”

verses.text: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.

xrefs.text: Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
“For our God is a consuming fire.”

“For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,” says the LORD of Hosts. “Not a root or branch will be left to them.”
Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

verses.text: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.

xrefs.text: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple. And there were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.

On the third day, when morning came, there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud was upon the mountain, and a very loud blast of the ram’s horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled.
He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.

verses.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.

xrefs.text: The mountains quake before Him, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles at His presence— the world and all its dwellers.
For behold, the LORD comes forth from His dwelling place; He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
The earth is utterly broken apart, the earth is split open, the earth is shaken violently.
If only You would rend the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake at Your presence,
He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.

verses.text: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.

xrefs.text: “And I, knowing their deeds and thoughts, am coming to gather all nations and tongues, and they will come and see My glory.
And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted—
For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.

verses.text: All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!

xrefs.text: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He says: “Let all God’s angels worship Him.”
But those who trust in idols and say to molten images, ‘You are our gods!’ will be turned back in utter shame.
Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels encircling the throne, and the living creatures and the elders. And their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.
[“]You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar; you must not place a sculpted stone in your land to bow down to it. For I am the LORD your God.

verses.text: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.

xrefs.text: Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.
Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.
Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, O Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your King comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the ends of the earth, “Say to Daughter Zion: See, your Savior comes! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:

verses.text: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.

xrefs.text: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”
But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.
Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,

verses.text: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

xrefs.text: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.
Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked and redeem you from the grasp of the ruthless.”
The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.

verses.text: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.

xrefs.text: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil— how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.
Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
Your decisions will be carried out, and light will shine on your ways.

verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.

xrefs.text: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.
Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
